metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Caller-owned identifiers such as batch or run IDs, stored as given and echoed in execution.completed. At most 32 keys matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$, 4096 serialized bytes.

FinalizedBy.title: FinalizedBy
FinalizedBy.description: What ended a MULTI Execution, or any Execution past its lifetime.

path.title: Path
path.description: Input file path relative to STORAGE_ROOT; no prefix is added.

path.title: Path
path.description: Python file path relative to STORAGE_ROOT; no prefix is added.

StatusReasonCode.title: StatusReasonCode
StatusReasonCode.description:
Why an Execution is in its status, where no other enum says so.

A FAILED Execution's reason is its FailureType, and one ended by
finalization or the maximum runtime carries its FinalizedBy.

code.title: Code
code.description: A FailureType for FAILED; AGENT, WAIT_TIMEOUT or MAX_RUNTIME for an Execution ended by finalization or its maximum runtime; otherwise a status-specific code such as CAPACITY_FULL for QUEUED.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Values behind the code: queue_position and per-Target targets for QUEUED, handover_reason and paused_since for WORKER_HANDOVER. Null when the code needs none.

StatusReasonResponse.title: StatusReasonResponse
StatusReasonResponse.description: Why the resource is in its status.

StepResultReference.title: StepResultReference
StepResultReference.description: Immutable Step result manifest in the Agent/Executor shared volume.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the value came from (body or header), then its field path.

context.title: Context
context.description: The values behind the reason, such as limit and actual.

APIKeyHeader.description: Caller API key; required on every API call.
APIKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key
